title: France Submits $34 Billion Rafale Proposal to India
summary: The French government has submitted a proposal to the Indian government to manufacture 94 Rafale fighter jets in India, with an estimated cost of $34 billion. The proposal includes plans for large-scale local manufacturing. France claims that this will increase India's military capabilities.
summary_points: France has submitted a $34 billion proposal to India for the purchase of 94 Rafale fighter jets.
The proposal includes plans for large-scale local manufacturing in India.
India is considering the proposal, which could potentially increase its military capabilities.
France claims that this will increase India's military capabilities.
The Indian government has not yet commented on the proposal.
The estimated cost of the deal is $34 billion.
